cognitum_ecosystem_hierarchy.paperclip_role: Independent execution coordination provider (not part of Cognitum ecosystem)

reusable_existing: agent-orchestration (core agent scheduling capabilities - overlap with Ruflo swarm, reuse EOS core)
observability (metrics collection, logging, tracing - telemetry overlap, use EOS for governance)
execution-provider-selection (dynamic Paperclip/Ruflo/Cognitum selection based on work complexity)
test isolation patterns (vitest-based isolated testing for adapters)
connector-ecosystem (base for MCP integration with Cognitum APIs)
apps/edge execution surface (reuse for Cognitum Seed integration)
governance-evidence (complement for Cognitum signed lineage/witness features)
required_new: Cognitum.One API client wrapper (pre-release API, only 52 of 60 verified endpoints exist, 8 missing)
Ruflo swarm execution adapter (isolated modular plugin only, no full runtime adoption)
Minimal MCP client (integrate with EOS connector-ecosystem, MCP gap confirmed)
Cognitum Agent Pods orchestration wrapper (isolated pod management, no work-core changes)
Ruflo multi-instance/race condition test suite extensions (required additional test cases)
Security boundary enforcement layer (complement Ruflo SafeExecutor with EOS tenant isolation, sandboxing, short-lived credentials)

critical_missing: MCP surface implementation (blocker not acute, per EOS-BOTTLENECK-ANALYSIS.md)
Cognitum.One API production readiness (pre-release, 8 endpoints missing, requires staging verification)
Ruflo sandbox isolation (Ruflo Mods run with host permissions, needs EOS security layer)
root monorepo ruflo init risk (full initialization modifies workspace, restricted per locked boundaries)

recommendations: MCP: Proceed with isolated evaluation, implement minimal MCP client only after staging verification of Cognitum API
Cognitum.One: Setup staging environment to validate 52 verified endpoints, authentication, tenant isolation, and test 8 missing endpoints
Ruflo: Maintain isolated evaluation, adopt only modular swarm coordination plugins - never install full Ruflo runtime on root monorepo
Paperclip: Keep as independent execution provider, never merge with Cognitum/Ruflo ecosystem before independent verification
Security: Implement EOS security boundary layer first - isolated execution, limited network egress, short-lived credentials, all outputs through governance-evidence
Execution Provider: Extend ExecutionProviderSelectionService with Cognitum Agent Pods rule ONLY after staging and security verification
EOS Boundaries: Preserve all locked boundaries - EOS remains Work owner, Cognitum/Ruflo act as execution adapters only
Reuse: Maximize reuse of existing work-core.atomicClaim for all external adapters to ensure exactly-once side effects
